name: cut
description: Cut a talking head in two calls; with footage, start here. On an empty timeline it builds the talking head from the sources (b-roll left out). Without plan: transcribes clips that have no transcript, per voiced run (the only file it writes beside a clip; the transcripts are trustworthy, never transcribe a window), removes silences (read on each clip's own audio) and fillers, and writes every saying as a row of cut-plan.md in the project folder, labeled where a take may be redone (retake?, false-start?, repeat?, noise?), changing nothing in the project; the answer carries the plan. With plan: applies that plan, edited or not (a version first), and answers with every seam: its time and the words each side. The language is detected unless you pass it.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: Plan: {project, mode: plan, speech, plan, labels {label: takes}, kept {lines, seconds}, removed {fillers, seconds, by {silence, fillers}, inaudible}, hardCuts, hardCutAt, duration, layers, next, previous?, transcribed, silence?, note?, notes?, warnings?, text (the plan, when under 12 KB)}. Apply: {project, mode: applied, seams ['<time> <3 words before> | <3 after>', ' (cuts a word)' when a seam falls inside a word], notes?, version, duration, undo, hardCuts, hardCutAt, layers, warnings?}. A tag is never refused: notes say what it does. hardCutAt: the seconds on the cut timeline of each hard cut. A cut project: {mode: already-cut, ...}.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: plan
params.description: Apply this plan: the path of the plan file in the project folder (cut-plan.md) is the normal way to pass it (a plan's text can pass the command line's size limit, 32K on Windows); the plan's text also works. Leave out to make a plan.

params.name: language
params.description: The speaker's language code (e.g. es). Leave out (or 'auto') to detect it. Picks the transcription language and the filler set.

params.name: max-pause
params.description: The longest pause kept as it is, in seconds: a silence longer than this (every moment 30 dB or more under the clip's own speech level) is cut to a breath each side. Default 0.45, which suits a talking head; 0.5 or more for tutorials.

params.name: breath
params.description: Seconds of silence kept on each side of the sound where a silence longer than max-pause is cut (and at the video's start and end); at a sentence end such a silence keeps up to 0.18 s in all. Used between 0.02 and half of max-pause. Default 0.04; raise it for a slower read.

params.name: speech
params.description: Where the speech is. auto (the default): of the sources heard (not muted), the one with the most transcribed seconds, else the voiceover. Or a video track id, audio:lane-<n> (the audio items of integer lane n), audio:<type> (audio items with no lane, of that type, e.g. audio:voiceover), or voiceover (the file at voiceover.src, or the audio that plays it). Audio is cut in place on audio.tracks; a voiceover's kept spans become voiceover items there.

params.name: silence-threshold
params.description: The level in dB below which the silence pass cuts (clips with no usable speech). Default -30; -42 or lower for a quiet speaker, who loses whole phrases at -30. The plan records it, and its apply uses the plan's.

params.name: recut
params.description: Plan again a project cut already cut. It cuts the current timeline, so takes the first cut removed stay removed.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer with the kept lines (keep).

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model for clips with no transcript.
